# Master MINDS (AI)

**Exceptional opening for international applicants until 19 May, midnight**  
   
 **A limited number of tuition fee reduction scholarships may be granted to outstanding international applicants.**  
   
 **Note: final application opportunity for non-EU applicants.**

The **Master MINDS** program is a two-year international master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced technologies, offered jointly by four prestigious European institutions: [INSA Lyon](https://www.insa-lyon.fr/en/)(France), the [University of Passau (UP)](https://www.uni-passau.de/en/) (Germany), the [University of Milan (UNIMI)](https://www.unimi.it/en) (Italy), and the [Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB)](https://www.uab.cat/web/universitat-autonoma-de-barcelona-1345467954774.html) (Spain). The program, taught entirely in English, aims to cultivate leaders in AI by combining cutting-edge technical expertise with a focus on societal impact and global perspectives.

A key feature of the program is its **international mobility**, requiring students to study in at least two of the participating countries. This approach fosters intercultural skills and broadens students’ global exposure. Spanning France, Germany, Italy, and Spain, the program offers a rich blend of expertise in AI through its curriculum and partnerships.

* [Program](#0)
* [Application](#0)
* [Consortium](#0)
* [Accommodation and Student Life](#0)
* [Contact](#0)

#### Curriculum highlights

The program focuses on three core AI themes:

* **Data Science and Data Engineering**
* **Cybersecurity**
* **Computer Vision**

During the **first year**, students develop a strong foundation in all three areas. The **second** **year** allows students to specialize in one of these themes during the first semester, followed by a master’s thesis, which can be completed either in an academic setting or during an industrial internship. This structure provides students with a solid balance of theoretical foundations and applied AI skills.

#### Practical learning and interactive experiences

The program emphasizes **hands-on learning** through interactive experiences:

* In the second semester of the first year, students tackle **group challenges proposed by industrial partners**, enhancing teamwork and real-world application skills.
* A **major project** during the second semester explores broader societal issues, such as the intersection of digital society and sustainable development, encouraging students to address the societal dimensions of AI innovation.
* The first semester of the second year concludes with a **hackathon**, enabling students to apply specialized knowledge in a dynamic, immersive setting.

#### Flexible research and Master Thesis options

The master’s thesis can be pursued at the institution hosting the third semester or any other location, provided collaborative agreements are in place. This flexibility allows students to align their research and practical experience with their career aspirations.  
Master MINDS provides graduates with both the technical expertise and global outlook needed to lead in the rapidly evolving field of AI.

#### Master MINDS Program

The Master MINDS program offers students the opportunity to obtain an INSA diploma along with a diploma supplement summarizing their specific academic path (specialization and mobility).

**The Common Core in M1 – Semesters 1 and 2**

The first year of the program, conducted by INSA Lyon with visiting professors from partner universities, comprises a common core that establishes the foundations of key AI domains, including data science and engineering, cybersecurity, computer vision, and robotics. Additionally, 15% of the curriculum is dedicated to humanities, entrepreneurship, and digital society, addressing fundamental topics such as ethics, deontology, sustainability, and the frugality of artificial intelligence.  
The humanities curriculum also includes linguistic studies in French, as well as German, Italian, or Spanish, depending on the student’s planned mobility during the second year and their proficiency level in French.  
Two projects enhance the first-year curriculum by enabling students to apply their acquired knowledge on a larger scale:

* **A second-semester group Challenge**, addressing real-world problems proposed by industrial partners.
* A year-long **Capstone project**, developed individually by students under the guidance of a faculty member.

This structure ensures a balanced blend of theoretical and practical learning.

**The Specialization in M2 – Semester 3**

Following the first year of the master's program, students specialize during the first semester of the second year in one of the following AI domains at one of the partner universities: AI for Engineering at the University of Passau, AI for Cybersecurity at the University of Milan, and AI for Computer Vision & Robotics at the Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB). This semester concludes with a Hackathon week at INSA Lyon, where students work in groups on a collective challenge, applying their specialist knowledge in a collaborative and dynamic setting.

**The Master Thesis in M2 – Semester 4**

The final semester is dedicated to the Master's Thesis, allowing each student to deeply investigate their chosen specialty. The internship is supervised by at least two advisors—either both from academia or a combination of academic and industry professionals. Co-supervision by specialized researchers fosters team cohesion and strengthens academic partnerships.

Upon completing the Master’s Thesis, students receive a diploma from INSA Lyon, accompanied by a diploma supplement that provides a detailed record of their entire academic journey, including their mobility during M2 at the university where they studied for at least six months.

#### Strengths of the Curriculum

The three specializations are taught by faculty members (researchers and professors) who are domain specialists, ideally positioned to identify and address cutting-edge topics in AI research and applications. The program offers **innovative educational approaches**, particularly in the realm of digital humanities, through methods such as inter-university challenges, specialist seminars involving industrial partners, group projects, and year-long projects that explore scientific themes through the lens of their societal impacts and challenges.

In addition to its focus on AI specializations, the program features **courses in humanities**, emphasizing topics related to digital society, languages, and entrepreneurship. This multidisciplinary approach ensures students gain a comprehensive understanding of the societal and ethical dimensions of AI.  
The program also boasts a **unique mobility structure within Europe**, enabling students to study in at least two European countries enabling students to study in at least two European countries. This unparalleled mobility enhances intercultural skills and positions the program as a leader in international AI education.  
Furthermore, the program is highly inclusive, fostering collaboration between businesses, and academia to create an alliance that actively contributes to the advancement of European initiatives in AI and education.

#### Main Professional Opportunities

Graduates of this curriculum are well-prepared for roles that require a strong understanding of modern AI concepts and technologies, such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Natural Language Processing. Additionally, their expertise extends to security systems, Computer Vision and Robotics, and advanced AI- based software engineering.  
Career opportunities span a range of sectors, including the digital industry, academia, and research. This broad skill set positions graduates for success in cutting-edge fields and interdisciplinary roles.

These reductions:

The new national fees for 2026/2027 will be announced before the summer break in 2026.

Please note that INSA does not offer a scholarship for this program. Additionally, if you hold a scholarship (such as the CROUS scholarship), please be aware that, if recognised for the MINDS Master’s program, it can only be applied towards the national fees and not towards the Master’s tuition fees of the MINDS program.

**French, European, “Études en France” (Campus France) or non-“Études en France” candidates:**

### ⚠ Mandatory procedure for international students

⬩ Applicants who **do not** hold citizenship of the **EU, EEA, Switzerland, Monaco, or Andorra** are required to obtain a Long-Stay Student Visa (VLS-TS) to study in France.  
⬩ In that case, applications **must** be submitted through the “Études en France” (Campus France) scheme. Please make sure to select the master MINDS program and communicate your Études en France with us on eCandidat otherwise your Études en France application will not be visible for us.

          ⬩ The Campus France application is **completed,** and

⬩ Applications submitted directly to INSA Lyon **without going through Campus France will not be considered**.

#### Prerequisites

* Bachelor’s degree, Master's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a related discipline.
* English proficiency is required, at least a certified B2 level in English (CECRL).
* No minimum level of French, German, Italian or Spanish is required.

#### Required documents

* A completed application form.
* Curriculum Vitae (3 pages max) in English, free or Europass format.
* A cover letter in English, explaining your motivation for the program and its relevance for your career.
* Certified English translation of the original Bachelor’s degree and/or Master's degree. In the case of degrees other than the Bachelor or integrated Master degree, a statement of comparability issued by ENIC-NARIC is required.
* Transcripts of academic records (grades), translated to English and certified.
* If the applicant has not completed the Bachelor’s or Master's degree at the time of application, she or he must provide certified English translations of available transcripts, a proof of current enrollment, and a declaration of the end date.
* Copy of passport. A scan of the national ID will be accepted conditionally if the applicant does not have a passport at the time of application.
* English language certificate.
* Optional: up to 2 recommendation letters from professors and/or employers.

#### English certficiation

Applicants need to provide proof for at least a certified B2 level in English (CECRL). This requirement applies to **all applicants**, including those who hold citizenship of a country where English is an official language. Either of the following certificates are accepted:

* IELTS: overall score of at least 7.0 with no sub-test below 6.5
* TOEFL iBT: overall score of at least 100 with no sub-test below 22 (**no** TOEFL iBT Home Edition)
* TOEIC: overall score of at least 800

Title: Insa Centre Val De Loire Campus De Blois Blois - Aiduka
# INSA Centre Val de Loire campus de Blois. L’INSA Centre Val de Loire, campus de Blois, est un **institut public** qui forme des **ingénieurs** et des **paysagistes‑concepteurs**. Implanté à Blois (Loir‑et‑Cher), le campus s’inscrit dans un environnement urbain et verdoyant au cœur de la vallée de la Loire. Il accueille la 1re année du cycle **STPI** et la spécialité **GSI**, ainsi que le département École de la nature et du paysage. La vie étudiante se déploie en centre‑ville, près de la gare, avec clubs et services présentés sur la page Vie étudiante de l’INSA CVL. L’ouverture sociale et internationale de l’institut est détaillée sur le site de l’INSA CVL. Après le bac, l’entrée en 1re année se fait via la **procédure INSA** sur **Parcoursup**, avec étude du dossier et éventuel entretien, comme indiqué sur la page Admission étudiants. Des **admissions parallèles** existent en 2e et 3e années pour titulaires de BUT/BTS/L2‑L3 ou de diplômes étrangers via le concours commun du Groupe INSA ; les candidats de **CPGE** postulent via SCEI. Certaines spécialités sont aussi ouvertes en **apprentissage** (selon les parcours) avec procédure dédiée sur le site de l’école. Sur ce campus, la spécialité **GSI** forme des ingénieurs polyvalents en performance et pilotage des systèmes de production, tandis que l’**École de la nature et du paysage** prépare en cinq ans au Diplôme d’État de paysagiste, présenté sur le site de l’ENP. Les enseignements s’appuient sur des laboratoires actifs (modélisation, matériaux, données, risques) et des projets ancrés dans les territoires. À l’international, l’INSA CVL dispose d’environ 100 accords dans 34 pays, recensés sur la page Partenaires internationaux, et bénéficie de la **charte Erasmus+ 2021‑2027** détaillée sur la page International. L'établissement INSA Centre Val de Loire campus de Blois est-il public ou privé ? L'établissement INSA Centre Val de Loire campus de Blois est un établissement d'enseignement supérieur. Où se trouve INSA Centre Val de Loire campus de Blois ? L'établissement est situé à Blois (Loir-et-Cher). Actuellement, INSA Centre Val de Loire campus de Blois propose 1 formations distinctes accessibles via la procédure Parcoursup. # Masters

INSA CVL offers 4 Masters to complete its training, 2 of which are accessible from the license (or equivalent diploma) and 2 with a Master 1. They are based on the technicality of our research laboratories and allow the acquisition of skills around themes popular with businesses.

## Master's degree in Applied Physics and Physics Engineering

**MASTER 1**

The Master addresses students interested in disciplines oriented toward applied physics and engineering sciences in the fields of electronic systems and components, instrumentation and ultrasounds, automatic, robotics and computer vision. It is also intended for students interested in the design of renewable energy systems. Students take scientific courses in applied mathematics and computer science, electronics, signal processing, automatic, instrumentation, ultrasound, etc., as well as in the behavior of organizations, scientific communication and professional English or French for foreign students.

[Master Presentation](https://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/sites/default/files/documents/2026/Master_Phys_Appl_Presentation_pr_candidats_English.pdf)

**In M1**, the recruitment is addressed to students: Bachelor's degree in EEA/ Physics/ Applied Physics/ Engineering Sciences, Electrical Engineering, Physical Measurement.  
INSA contact for M1:[Michaël Lemtre](mailto:michael.lematre@insa-cvl.fr)[David Folio](mailto:david.folio@insa-cvl.fr)At the end of the Master 1, students can join one of the two Master 2 tracks of the master: Electronics, Instrumentation and Ultrasound for the first track, and Automatic Robotics and Computer Vision for the second one.

---

**MASTER 2**

The M2 program is based on research themes of INSA laboratories, such as Instrumentation and Ultrasonic Systems (GREMAN Laboratory), as well as Automatic and Robotics (PRISME Laboratory), and on themes of national and international interest, such as the study and design of renewable energy systems. The M2 addresses students who have completed the M1 program, as well as engineering students wishing to complete their final year with a Master's degree focused on research, and international students.

[Application file for M2](https://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/sites/default/files/documents/2024/formulaire_m1-m2_2024-25.pdf)

* **M2 Track 2:** Automatic, Robotics and Computer Vision (Bourges campus)  
  INSA contact: Vincent Idasiak (Bourges campus). Courses are taught in English.[Vincent Idasiak](mailto:vincent.idaziak@insa-cvl.fr)
